performance.verdict: Six overdue milestones are bleeding intake capacity; leads are structural, not algorithmic.

findings.text: 4 SOW milestones overdue since Aug 31: intake owner unconfirmed, booking bot untested, Review Boost unlaunched, financing page and Homer Glen branch not live — blocking scale-up gate.

2 additional SOW milestones overdue: LSA heating toggles (due Sep 1) and booking bot battle-test (due Jul 31) both unresolved — LSA re-enable directly suppresses lead volume entering fall heating season.

CPL spiked 33% to $215.59 vs prior 7d, with only 8 leads on $1,724 28-day spend. 3-day signal (Sep 15–17): 1 lead on $221.82 vs prior 3 days (Sep 12–14): 1 lead on $128.53 — efficiency is not recovering.

GBP call rates on Fibid Heating (0.79%) and Quality HVAC by Fibid (0.45%) are critically low vs Quality HVAC Solutions (2.52%) on 1,073 impressions — two profiles are visible but not converting intent to calls.
GHL shows 981 opportunities created but only 46 won in 28 days, with 0 appointments logged — intake owner vacancy (post Vivian, Jul 7) likely means leads arrive but no one is advancing them in CRM.

suggestions.text: Confirm intake owner with GHL login this week; unblocks scale-up gate and stops lead abandonment at 981 open opps.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian left 7/7 and the intake seat is unconfirmed; speed-to-lead automations are pointing at an empty role. With 981 GHL opportunities created but 0 appointments logged, leads are arriving and stalling. Nacer to confirm the named intake owner, verify their GHL login is active, and confirm after-hours coverage by 2026-09-22. Success = a named owner in GHL with a confirmed login and at least one test appointment created.

suggestions.text: Escalate LSA heating toggle re-enable (overdue Sep 1); fall heating season demand is live and LSA is dark.

Sohib to confirm with Nader/Xavier that dispatch capacity can absorb incremental LSA volume, then enable heating toggles by 2026-09-22.
